title: A message left behind
hook: A signal can remain after its maker moves on.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors suited to particular conditions.
doesNotKnow: The colored mark stays on the tree while the animal moves away in this schematic. Chemical scent marks can persist and carry information to other mammals, but the content and duration depend on species and conditions.

misconception: A familiar animal behavior or structure must work in a different way.
objective: In this scent-mark example, what can another mammal encounter after the first has left?
